verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a self-hosted AI runtime with chat history, agents and multi-user accounts, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a way to export user data (chats, agent configs, usage records) in open formats. OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility and loading open-format GGUF models from Hugging Face are interoperability features, not a data-export capability, so they earn no credit here.
